<thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense peak is at m/z 121.0528, which corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the proton mass (1.0073 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈120.0455 Da. The formula that matches this mass within typical mass‑spectrometric tolerance is C₄H₈O₄ (exact monoisotopic mass = 120.0423 Da). No other common elements are indicated, and the DBE of 1 is consistent with a single carbonyl or ring. Therefore the molecular formula is C4H8O4.</thought>
<final_answer>C4H8O4</final_answer>
